non_outcomes: plan without an accepted implementation artifact

objectives.outcome: Deterministic governed delivery across the estate
objectives.success_metric: At least one campaign contract is admitted, executed, and verified against canonical estate policy.
A tested reliability, interoperability, or adoption improvement reaches reviewable PR state with conformance evidence.

objectives.outcome: Calm local visibility and receipt-backed actions
objectives.success_metric: One operator flow becomes measurably clearer or safer and records a machine-readable action receipt.
One live status or decision surface is verified against its source and tested.
A campaign produces objective-linked artifacts and passed verification receipts while respecting quota, branch, storage, and concurrency gates.
One tested change reduces qualified purchase, delivery, or upgrade friction without triggering duplicate deployment paths.
One offer or content asset is grounded in product proof and connected to a measurable qualified action.

objectives.outcome: First creation and retained creative use
objectives.success_metric: One canon-safe tested flow improves time to first creation or repeat creative use.
One tested product change removes purchase-to-activation or upgrade friction and reaches reviewable PR state.
One important visual artifact passes provenance, export inspection, responsive QA, and the premium score gate.
One real pilot or contribution loop is executable and yields a measured activation or repeat-contribution signal.
A maker and independent verifier return acknowledged receipts for a bounded job without duplicate writers.
One end-to-end creator workflow is tested, repeatable, and produces a useful artifact.
One consent-safe distribution experiment records audience, action, and learning evidence.
One conformance example passes the standard in a second implementation context.
One real task resolves to an available capability and produces an acknowledged result.
One compatibility or safety defect is reproduced, fixed, and covered by a regression test.
One music operation records source, prompt, output, and verification provenance end to end.
One reusable workflow produces an inspected artifact that passes its documented quality gate.
One learner reaches a useful first result and the activation evidence is recorded.
One community flow records activation and a qualified paid-wrapper signal.

objectives.outcome: Audience and partner signal before infrastructure
objectives.success_metric: One evidence-backed audience or partner signal is recorded before new infrastructure is authorized.

objectives.outcome: Cohort completion and qualified enterprise lead
objectives.success_metric: One cohort flow records completion evidence or a qualified enterprise lead signal.
